title: r37#5 林晚非脸部裁切候选：只给说明

steps.clickAt: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button.hub-face-img')].find(x=>x.getAttribute('data-crop')==='no' && !x.querySelector('.hub-badge.ok')); if(!b) return [null,null]; b.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); const r=b.getBoundingClientRect(); return [r.x+r.width/2, r.y+r.height/2]; })()

title: r37#5 林晚脸部裁切候选：照常提交（写请求被拦）

steps.clickAt: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button.hub-face-img')].find(x=>x.getAttribute('data-crop')!=='no' && !x.querySelector('.hub-badge.ok')); if(!b) return [null,null]; b.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); const r=b.getBoundingClientRect(); return [r.x+r.width/2, r.y+r.height/2]; })()
